new_jobs.title: Director
new_jobs.jd: **Company Description** Compal Electronics Inc. is one of the world’s leading original design manufacturers, providing innovative solutions across consumer electronics, information technology, and communication devices. Headquartered in Taipei City, the company partners with global brands to design, engineer, and manufacture high-quality products at scale. Compal emphasizes technological innovation, operational excellence, and long-term customer relationships. Team members benefit from an international, fast-paced environment focused on continuous improvement and professional growth. **Role Description** The Director role at Compal Electronics Inc. is a full-time, on-site position based in Taipei City. This role oversees strategic planning and execution for a defined business unit or function, ensuring alignment with company goals and market demands. The Director leads cross-functional teams, sets performance objectives, and manages budgets, resources, and key projects from concept to delivery. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing operational and financial performance, guiding decision-making, resolving escalated issues, and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. The Director is also expected to mentor team members, implement governance and risk management practices, and drive continuous improvement in processes, quality, and efficiency. **Qualifications** * Demonstrated leadership and people management skills, including team building, performance management, and mentoring. * Strong strategic planning, business analysis, and decision-making abilities in a complex, fast-paced environment. * Experience managing cross-functional projects, budgets, and timelines, with a focus on operational excellence and quality. * Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across cultures and disciplines. * Background in electronics, manufacturing, or technology industries is highly beneficial. * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Management, or a related field; an advanced degree (e.g., MBA) is a plus. * Proficiency in English for business communication; Mandarin or additional language skills are advantageous. * Ability to work on-site in Taipei City and collaborate effectively with global teams and partners.

new_jobs.title: Solution Operations & Service Strategy Manager_Delta Solution Office(Taipei)
new_jobs.jd: **【Who we are】** We are Delta Solution Office (DSO), a corporate team driving Delta’s transformation from a hardware-focused company into a provider of integrated hardware and software solutions. We work across Business Groups, IT, service organizations, and regional teams to build scalable solution capabilities and new vertical solution businesses. **【Role Overview】** Delta is expanding from hardware products toward software-enabled and recurring solution businesses. We are looking for a Solution Operations & Service Strategy Manager to help design how these new solutions should be operated, supported, governed, and scaled globally. This is a 0-to-1 role. You will not inherit an established software operations organization; you will help build the operating model and work with Delta’s existing IT, Service, BG, and regional organizations to make it real. **【Key Responsibilities】** * Define the operating model for software-enabled and cross-BG solutions. * Establish service ownership, support tiers, escalation paths, and cross-functional R&R. * Define standards for SLA, incident, problem, change, release, and lifecycle management. * Establish service-readiness criteria before new solution launches. * Recommend software / solution support models that complement Delta’s existing hardware service organization. * Build reusable playbooks, KPIs, governance mechanisms, and operating processes. * Help shape and eventually lead a future Solution Service & Operations capability. **【Role Requirements】** **Required** * 7+ years of experience in SaaS / Software Operations, Solution Operations, Service Strategy, Customer Success Operations, or related roles. * Experience designing or improving enterprise software operating models. * Strong knowledge of SLA, incident / problem / change / release management. * Proven ability to build processes across multiple organizations. * Strong business and stakeholder-management capability. * Fluent in English and Chinese. **Preferred** * Experience from leading SaaS, enterprise software, cloud, or digital-solution companies. * Experience at Siemens, Schneider Electric, or similar industrial-digital companies is a plus. * Experience building a new operations or service-management function from the ground up. **What Success Looks Like** * Establish a reusable software / solution service operating model. * Define clear SLA, escalation, incident, release, and lifecycle-management mechanisms. * Clarify service ownership across BG / IT / Service / Region / Solution teams. * Create the foundation for a future Solution Service & Operations team.

new_jobs.title: Senior Commercial Excellence Manager-RGM, Customer Centricity
new_jobs.jd: **JOB SUMMARY** Drive strategic alignment between commercial growth and customer profitability interests by integrating Revenue Growth Management (RGM) and Customer Centricity. RGM is fundamentally about driving profitable growth through levers such as pack/price architecture, trade terms, promotions, and product mix optimization. These levers directly impact customer profitability, making Customer Centricity a natural extension of RGM. By embedding Joint Business Planning (JBP), shopper insights, and innovation strategies like PPA, this role ensures that commercial strategies are rooted in understanding and delivering customer value. Grouping RGM with Customer Centricity enables a more strategic and value-driven approach to customer partnerships, fostering sustainable growth and mutual success across markets. **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES** * Lead the strategic integration of Revenue Growth Management (RGM) and Customer Centricity to drive profitable, customer-aligned growth across diverse markets. * Deliver balanced RGM strategies using five core levers: * Pack/Price Architecture (PPA): Embed consistent strategy and protocols across markets. * SKU Optimization: Align portfolio strategy with channel and shopper needs. * Pricing & Promo Governance: Maintain pricing audits and promotional tracking to ensure competitiveness and margin delivery. * Product x Channel Strategy: Improve mix and conversion through targeted channel strategies. * Trade Investment & Rebate Optimization: Enhance ROI and align incentives with performance goals. * Co-lead RGM initiatives with Commercial Excellence Lead of Cluster to ensure strategic alignment and execution excellence. * Improve customer sentiment across digital and physical touchpoints. * Support and coach Joint Business Planning (JBP) processes to foster collaborative growth. * Strengthen customer partnerships through value-based engagement and tailored solutions. * Identify and unlock growth opportunities in digital channels. * Develop tailored portfolio-PPA strategies for online platforms. * Optimize pricing and promotional strategies to drive conversion and profitability. * Develop and automate performance dashboards related to RGM levers. * Provide on-demand analytics support (e.g., sell-in/sell-out reconciliation, internal offtake, Nielsen consumption). * Use tools like Power BI, Salesforce, and NielsenIQ for data-driven decision-making. * Embed agile practices including sprint planning, retrospectives, and agile governance. * Align strategies across functions and markets for rapid course correction and continuous improvement. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field. * 7–10 years of experience in FMCG, with a strong background in Commercial Excellence, RGM, or related fields. * Proven expertise in category management, shopper marketing, and strategic planning. * Strong project management and problem-solving skills. * Excellent influencing and networking abilities across all levels of the organization. * Business acumen with a holistic view of commercial performance. * Willingness to travel and engage in Gemba activities across markets.

new_jobs.title: (Senior) Strategy Associate

Cut through the noise, get straight to the crux of the issue, and simplify solutions in an elegant, actionable way. * **Drive Fast Results:** Translate strategic thinking into immediate business actions, leveraging clear and concise communication to align stakeholders and drive execution. **What We Look For** * **Experience:** 1 to 3 years of full-time work experience * **Background:** Relevant experience in fintech and/or strategy. Experience in top-tier strategy consulting is highly preferred. * **Track Record of Excellence:** Candidates with above-average ratings in past performance reviews will be strongly prioritized *.* * **Original Critical Thinkers:** You possess a high degree of original thought, business acumen, and the ability to synthesize complex information better and faster than AI. * **Curiosity Over Prior Knowledge:** No prior knowledge of crypto, tokenized assets, or predictions is required (though it is a plus!). new_jobs.title: (HQ) Project Manager
new_jobs.jd: We’re looking for a Project Manager who thrives at the intersection of business, technology, and AI. You will own the client onboarding journey — shaping business processes, EDI integrations, billing and charge logic, and reporting specs — while working shoulder-to-shoulder with our in-house developers to design and refine the platforms that power our operations. Our business volume is growing fast — client tickets are up 60% year-over-year — and we are scaling the team to keep pace. As a truly AI-forward company, we expect you to leverage AI fluently to multiply your impact and help our lean, high-performing team keep scaling capacity faster than headcount. **About Our Team:** * We are an AI-first PM team: AI tools such as Copilot and Claude are part of our daily workflow, extended with a growing library of custom skills, agents, and workflows that accelerate every stage of a project. * We use Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint for end-to-end ticket management, documentation, and knowledge-base sharing. * We create system screen and process-flow mockups with Miro and AI-built prototypes. * We encourage using automation and AI-built tools to streamline workflows and minimize manual work. * We have a structured onboarding and training program to help you join the team seamlessly and work side by side with us. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **New Development & Client Onboarding (40%)** * Lead the end-to-end onboarding of new clients on our internal platforms, from kickoff to go-live. * Gather and validate business requirements; design EDI flows and report specifications. * Translate requirements into clear, build-ready specs and mockups for the development team. * Ensure every project is delivered on time, on scope, and on quality. **Platform Operations & Maintenance (25%)** * Own the day-to-day health of the platforms and integrations you've launched. * Triage issues, prioritize enhancements, and manage change requests. * Partner with engineering so clients keep getting value long after go-live — not just a launch. **Cross-functional Communication & Stakeholder Management (20%)** * Act as the bridge between clients, operations, finance, and our software development team. * Run requirement workshops, process reviews, and user training; lead status reviews and align expectations. * Turn ambiguous business conversations into structured decisions everyone can act on. **Continuous Improvement & AI-Driven Innovation (15%)** * Use AI tools (Copilot, Claude) fluently across analysis, documentation, and decision-making. * Build and refine AI skills, agents, and automations that reduce manual work for the team. * Bring forward ideas that help our lean team punch far above its weight. **JOB QUALIFICATIONS** **Education/Technical Skills** * Bachelor’s degree or above in Information Management, Computer Science, IE, or related fields; PMP / Agile certifications a plus. * Solid knowledge of EDI standards (EDIFACT, X12, XML/JSON, APIs) and system integration concepts. * Skilled in writing functional specs, report specs, and process flows; able to read data models and basic SQL. * Fluent use of modern AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate analysis and delivery. **Knowledge/Work Experience** * 5+ years as a PM, BA, or Implementation Consultant on internally developed or enterprise platforms. * Proven track record leading client onboarding involving system integration, EDI, and custom reporting. * Strong experience working with in-house dev teams across the full SDLC. * Logistics, freight forwarding, or supply chain background highly preferred. * Experience with e-commerce, payment, billing, or financial systems is a plus — such as order management, invoicing and settlement, or transaction reconciliation. **Key Behavioral Competencies** * Strong communicator and stakeholder manager who thrives in ambiguity. * Structured thinker with sharp prioritization and a strong sense of ownership. * True team player — curious, collaborative, and comfortable challenging ideas. * Growth-oriented and AI-curious; constantly raising the bar on how work gets done.

new_jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer - Agent/AI Solutions
new_jobs.company: 訊凱國際 Cooler Master Co., Ltd.
new_jobs.jd: **關於這個角色：** 在 Cooler Master，我們不僅打造頂尖硬體，更致力於推動產業的智慧轉型。我們正在尋找一位具備敏銳商業嗅覺與扎實技術底蘊的「 **資深 AI 軟體工程師** 」。 這不是一個純粹在背景訓練模型的職位。你將成為 AI 解決方案的架構師與推動者，深入業務、製造與 IT 等核心部門，將模糊的營運痛點轉化為具體的 AI 應用。如果你熱衷於從零到一打造 AI Agent、優化 RAG 系統，並渴望看到你的程式碼在真實商業場景中發揮巨大影響力，歡迎加入我們！ **你將發揮的影響力（核心職責）：** * **技術與商業的橋樑** ：主導跨部門需求訪談，精準拆解業務流程與痛點，並將其轉化為清晰的 AI 應用架構與解決方案。 * **AI 系統設計與開發** ：設計並實作高可用性的 AI Agent 與 Workflow（運用 n8n / Dify 或自建系統），建立並持續優化 RAG 系統，打造強大的 Copilot 與生成式應用。 * **模型選型與落地整合** ：針對不同商業場景，靈活評估並整合最合適的模型（LLM、VLM、影像生成、STT、TTS）；串接雲端 API 或部署本地端開源模型（如 vLLM、Ollama）。 * **全端整合思維** ：將強大的 AI 能力封裝並無縫整合至企業實際運行的系統中（包含內部工具、Web UI 及 API），全面升級使用者體驗。 * **專案推動與落地** ：與技術、業務及管理團隊緊密協作，確保 AI 專案不僅在技術上可行，更能順利落地並創造實際商業價值。 **我們期待你具備的實力（必要條件）：** * **5** 年以上軟體開發經驗，精通 Python 或其他後端開發語言。 * 具備將 LLM 或生成式 AI API（OpenAI 或各類開源模型）導入實際專案的實戰經驗。 * 深刻理解 Prompt Engineering、RAG 及多模態（Multimodal）基本概念與應用。 * 具備扎實的 API 串接與複雜系統整合能力。 * 擁有出色的邏輯拆解與需求分析能力，能將龐雜的問題收斂為明確的執行目標。 * 具備高度的跨部門溝通協調能力，能在不同思維的團隊間游刃有餘。 **如果你有這些，將會更加驚豔（加分條件）：** * 曾擔任技術主管 (Tech Lead)，或擁有專案導入、系統架構設計的實務經驗。 * 熟悉 LangChain、Dify、n8n 等主流 AI 應用開發框架與自動化工具。 * 具備向量資料庫（如 FAISS、Milvus、Chroma 等）的實際建置經驗。 * 擁有本地模型部署與推論加速經驗（如 vLLM、Ollama）。 * 具備影像處理模型（如 YOLO、CLIP）或生成式模型的應用經驗。 * 熟悉 Docker / Kubernetes，具備現代化 MLOps 或 DevOps 部署概念。

new_jobs.jd: **Job Details** Job Description: **The Role and Impact** The substrate supply chain is the focal point of Intel supply capabilities. As a Substrate Supply Operations Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring the seamless planning and execution of complex substrate sourcing operations by balancing the substrate supplier sourcing strategies with our customer requirements. Your daily responsibilities will include leveraging advanced analytics to optimize inventory, materials, and logistics while collaborating with cross-functional teams to meet customer requirements. Your work will directly impact Intel's ability to deliver innovative solutions efficiently, driving operational excellence across the supply chain. **Business group** You will be part of Intel Foundry, a dynamic and innovative business group dedicated to enabling the development and delivery of cutting-edge semiconductor solutions. The Substrate Supply team focuses on optimizing SOE substrate supply chain processes to support Intel's broader goals of delivering high-quality products to customers worldwide. Through collaboration with various departments, Intel Foundry plays a pivotal role in advancing Intel's leadership in the industry. **Key Responsibilities** * Plan and manage complex supply chain links, ensuring smooth execution of schedules, materials, forecasts, build plans, and capacity requirements. * Collaborate closely with IPG, IFS, Planning and the supplier development teams to support both standard and custom solutions from a materials and supply chain perspective. * Apply mathematics, statistics, advanced analytics, and optimization modeling to uncover patterns in data and drive cost-efficient strategies. * Create and maintain data structures and standardized reporting systems to align with supply chain business strategies. * Establish and manage supply chain databases, dashboards, and reports to track performance metrics and identify areas for improvement. * Proactively manage supply disruption events, communicating adjustments and tradeoffs to stakeholders while maintaining alignment with customer demand priorities. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, logistics, industrial engineering, operations research, or a related field. * 5+ years of relevant experience in supply chain planning, logistics, or operations management OR 4+ years of experience with a Master's degree OR 2+ years of experience with a PhD. * Proficiency in using advanced analytics tools and optimization modeling techniques. * Experience with developing and maintaining databases, dashboards, and standardized reporting systems. * Strong analytical skills with a demonstrated capability to translate data insights into actionable strategies. * Experience dealing with Executive presentations, being capable to zoom in / zoom out complicated business cases and be able to ingrate win / win strategies. * Proficiency communicating in Mandarin (written/verbal). **Preferred Qualifications** * Advanced certifications in supply chain management, logistics, or relevant fields. * Proven ability to manage supply chain disruption events and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams. * Experience working collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment. * Strong problem-solving and communication skills to influence and drive decision-making processes across teams. We're looking for individuals who are passionate about making an impact, ready to tackle complex challenges, and eager to grow their careers within a world-class organization. Join us in driving innovation and excellence in supply chain management. **Job Type** Experienced Hire **Shift** Shift 1 (Malaysia) Primary Location: Malaysia, Penang Additional Locations: Japan, Tokyo, PRC, Chengdu, PRC, Shanghai, Taiwan, Hsinchu **Posting Statement** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, religious creed, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military and veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender, gender expression, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by local law, regulation, or ordinance. Position of Trust N/A **Work Model for this Role** This role will be eligible for our hybrid work model which allows employees to split their time between working on-site at their assigned Intel site and off-site. \* Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

new_jobs.jd: **Company Introduction** Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond. We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” **Role Overview** As the Principal, Creator & Affiliate Partnerships, you will own the strategic development and business growth of Coupang Taiwan's Creator & Affiliate ecosystem. marketing, operations, and business teams. **What You Will Do** **Creator Acquisition & Partner Management** * Own creator acquisition and ecosystem growth strategies across key social and content platforms. * Build and manage strategic partnerships with creators, MCNs, agencies, and affiliate partners. * Drive creator engagement, retention, and monetization through scalable partnership programs and growth initiatives. * Expand creator participation and strengthen Coupang’s position within Taiwan’s creator economy. * Identify and develop new partnership opportunities that accelerate ecosystem growth and business impact. **Affiliate Ecosystem & Monetization Strategy** * Own the strategy and growth of Coupang Taiwan's affiliate ecosystem, including partner acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization. * Define affiliate business models, commission structures, incentive programs, and partner segmentation frameworks. * Drive ecosystem growth and revenue through strategic partnerships, scalable monetization initiatives, and performance optimization. * Leverage data, market insights, and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities and shape business strategy. * Influence cross-functional teams to enhance platform capabilities and unlock new monetization opportunities. **Campaign & Platform Operations** * Lead creator and affiliate programs to drive engagement, monetization, and ecosystem growth. * Build scalable campaign frameworks and operational best practices across creator and affiliate initiatives. * Monitor program performance and drive cross-functional improvements to enhance partner experience and business outcomes. * Develop strong relationships with creators, agencies, and key ecosystem partners. **Contracting, Commission & Payment Operations** * Establish scalable contracting, commission, and payment processes for creators and affiliate partners. * Oversee commission structures, revenue-sharing programs, and partner incentive mechanisms. * Partner with Finance, Legal, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and operational excellence. * Continuously improve partner onboarding, settlement, and payment experiences. **Process Improvement & Data Analytics** * Define and optimize creator lifecycle and affiliate program operating frameworks. * Establish key metrics and performance reporting to track ecosystem growth and health. * Leverage data insights to identify growth opportunities and drive business improvements. * Drive operational excellence through process optimization and scalable best practices. **Basic Qualifications** * 8+ years of experience in Creator Economy, Affiliate Marketing, Influencer Partnerships, Business Development, E-commerce, Digital Marketing, or related fields. * Proven experience building and scaling creator, affiliate, or partnership ecosystems, with demonstrated impact on business growth and partner engagement. * Strong understanding of creator monetization models, affiliate marketing, social commerce, and performance marketing. * Experience managing strategic partnerships with creators, agencies, MCNs, affiliate networks, or ecosystem partners. * Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and cross-functional leadership skills. * Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive business outcomes across multiple stakeholders without direct authority. * Data-driven mindset with experience using performance metrics and insights to inform growth strategies and business decisions. * Professional proficiency in both Mandarin and English. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in creator commerce, affiliate platforms, affiliate networks, or social commerce ecosystems. * Experience designing commission structures, revenue-sharing programs, or creator incentive models. * Strong understanding of affiliate monetization, creator economy, and ecosystem growth strategies. * Experience driving partner acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization initiatives. * Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and business development skills. * Passion for creator economy, digital platforms, and partnership growth. **Recruitment Process and Others** **Recruitment Process** * Application Review - Phone Interview - Onsite (or Virtual Onsite) Interview – Offer * The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process. * Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. **Privacy Notice** * Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below: https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy-policy/ **公司簡介（Company Introduction）** Coupang 正在重新定義購物體驗，致力於讓每位顧客從開啟 Coupang App 的那一刻起，到商品送達家門的瞬間，都能享受到令人驚艷的服務體驗。 Coupang new_jobs.title: Senior Digital Twin Engineer - (3D/Omniverse/ Physical AI)
new_jobs.company: 訊凱國際 Cooler Master Co., Ltd.
new_jobs.jd: **【 About the Role 】** 在 Cooler Master，我們正在重新定義軟硬體整合與智慧製造的未來！作為資深數位孿生工程師，你將站在 NVIDIA Omniverse 平台與 Physical AI（物理 AI）的最前線，將前沿的 3D 視覺化技術、LLM Agent 與具身智能（Robotics / Isaac Sim）深度融合。你將與頂尖的跨領域團隊並肩作戰，構建從物理世界到虛擬場景、從高真度模擬到 AI 決策的完整工業數位孿生生態系。 **【Why Join Us? 】** * **前沿技術落地：** 全面導入 NVIDIA Omniverse、USD 核心架構與 Isaac Sim，打造次世代 AI 智慧工廠與研發/生產自動化模擬。 * **資產數位化、Physical AI & 合成資料應用：** 透過 2D/3D 合成資料生成（Synthetic Data Generation）與機器人模擬，解決真實世界數據稀缺問題，推動生成式 AI 與具身智能真實落地。 * **跨領域技術樞紐：** 連結工業設計（CAD/BIM）、電腦圖學（Graphics）與深度學習（AI/MLOps），成為引領 Cooler Master 數位轉型的關鍵技術推手。 **【Key Responsibilities 】** 1. **數位孿生生態系建構：** 結合 NVIDIA Omniverse 與 Cooler Master 產品生態，開發從高真度 3D 視覺化到 AI 智慧決策的工業級數位孿生解決方案。 2. **USD 3D 資產 Pipeline 優化：** 將工業級 CAD/BIM 模型精準轉換為高效能 USD (Universal Scene Description) 格式，優化 RTX 渲染效能與物理真實感（PBR）。 3. **程序化與自動化工具開發：** 使用 Python/C++ 開發程序化建模（Procedural Generation）工具與 3D 資產自動佈置腳本，提升大型場景建構效率。 4. **合成資料（Synthetic Data）生成：** 設計並建構 3D 虛擬訓練環境，產生高質量的合成數據，驅動 Computer Vision 與 AI 模型的訓練與驗證。 5. **AI/LLM 與機器人模擬整合：** 研究並導入最新 NVIDIA SDKs，將 LLM Agent 與 Isaac Sim 整合至虛擬場景，實作智慧機器人與自動化流程之仿真部署。 6. **系統效能與品質導向：** 於「視覺真實度」與「實時執行效能」之間取得最佳平衡，建立技術規範與資產標準化流程。 **【 Basic Qualifications 】** * **工作經驗：** 3 年以上相關電腦視覺開發經驗，具備電腦圖學、物理模擬或 AI 工程原理基礎知識。 * **核心程式語言：** 精通 **Python** （Omniverse 核心開發語言），具備 **C++** 開發經驗者佳。 * **Omniverse 與 USD 架構：** 熟悉 NVIDIA Omniverse 生態（USD Composer、Isaac Sim）及 USD (Universal Scene Description) 架構。 * **3D 工具與渲染技術：** * 熟悉工業 CAD/BIM 軟體（如 SolidWorks、Revit） **或** 3D 創作軟體（如 Blender、Maya、3ds Max）。 * 理解 PBR 材質、光照、UV 展開及法線貼圖等視覺與圖學原理。 * **軟實力與語言：** 具備良好技術 **中英文** 閱讀與溝通能力，能順暢閱讀國外原廠 API 文件，並具備跨團隊（客戶、美術專家、AI 研發團隊）溝通協調與問題解決能力。 **【 Preferred Qualifications 】** 1. 具備智慧工廠、工業自動化或智慧製造相關產業背景。具備相關專案落地經驗者優先錄取。 2. 熟悉工業模擬與工程分析工具（如 CAE、CFD、FEA 等）。 3. 具備 Computer Vision、PyTorch、MLOps 或深度學習專案實作經驗。 -- **【 About the Role 】** At Cooler Master, we are reimagining the future of hardware-software integration and smart manufacturing. As a Senior Digital Twin Engineer, you will stand at the forefront of NVIDIA Omniverse and Physical AI, seamlessly blending high-fidelity 3D visualization, LLM Agents, and robotics simulation (Isaac Sim). You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build an end-to-end industrial digital twin ecosystem—bridging physical reality and virtual simulation to power next-generation AI-driven decision systems. **【 Why Join Cooler Master? 】** * **Cutting-Edge Tech Stack:** Deeply leverage NVIDIA Omniverse, USD architecture, and Isaac Sim to shape next-generation smart factory simulations. * **Real-World Physical AI Impact:** Harness 2D/3D Synthetic Data generation and robotics simulation to overcome real-world data scarcity and deploy embodied AI solutions. * **Cross-Disciplinary Innovation:** Bridge industrial CAD/BIM engineering, computer graphics, and generative AI/MLOps into scalable, enterprise-grade applications. **【 Key Responsibilities 】** 1. **Digital Twin Ecosystem Architecture:** Integrate NVIDIA Omniverse with Cooler Master's product portfolio to deliver end-to-end industrial digital twin solutions—from 3D visualization to AI-driven decision engines. 2. **USD & 3D Pipeline Optimization:** Transform industrial CAD/BIM assets into optimized Universal Scene Description (USD) formats, ensuring maximum real-time physics fidelity and RTX photorealistic rendering. 3. **Procedural Generation & Automation:** Develop Python/C++ scripts and procedural generation engines to automate 3D scene creation and asset layouts. 4. **Synthetic Data Generation (SDG):** Design 3D simulation environments to generate high-quality synthetic datasets for training and validating Computer Vision and AI models. 5. **AI/LLM & Isaac Sim Integration:** Implement the latest NVIDIA SDKs to integrate LLM Agents and robotics simulation (Isaac Sim) into virtual environments for AI model deployment and validation. 6. **Performance & Quality Standards:** Drive resource assessment and technical trade-offs between rendering fidelity and system performance, establishing unified production guidelines. **【 Qualifications 】** * **Experience:** **3+** years of relevant computer vision engineering experience with a solid grasp of computer graphics, physical simulation, or foundational AI engineering principles. * **Programming Languages:** Proficient in **Python** (primary language for Omniverse); experience in **C++** is strongly preferred. * **3D & Omniverse Ecosystem:** Familiarity with NVIDIA Omniverse (USD Composer, Isaac Sim) and core USD (Universal Scene Description) framework. * **Software & Rendering Skills:** * Proficiency in CAD/BIM software (SolidWorks, Revit) **or** 3D DCC tools (Blender, Maya, 3ds Max). * Solid understanding of PBR texturing, lighting, UV unwrapping, and normal mapping principles. * **Soft Skills & Language:** Working knowledge of technical **Chinese/English** to read API documentation and technical specifications; strong problem-solving skills and cross-functional communication abilities (engaging with domain experts, artists, and AI R&D teams). **【 Preferred Qualifications 】** 1. Background in Smart Factory, Industrial Automation, or Advanced Manufacturing. Actual manufacturing sites implementation experience is highly preferred. 2. Experience with engineering simulation tools (e.g., CAE, CFD, FEA). 3. Hands-on experience in Computer Vision, PyTorch, MLOps, or Deep Learning pipelines.
